about.title: about
about.description: Desktop AI meeting assistant. Real-time transcription via Deepgram, Google, OpenAI Whisper, ElevenLabs or on-device Parakeet; answers via Vercel AI Gateway, Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, Groq or local Ollama. Sessions stored locally.

stt_fields.google_setup_help_title: How to set up Google Speech-to-Text
stt_fields.google_setup_help_body:
1. Open console.cloud.google.com → create or pick a project; copy its ID into the field above.
2. In the project: APIs & Services → enable “Cloud Speech-to-Text API”.
3. Auth — pick one:
   • Easiest: install the gcloud CLI, run gcloud auth application-default login once. Leave the JSON field blank.
   • Or: IAM → Service Accounts → create one with “Cloud Speech Client” role → keys → create JSON → paste contents into the field above.
stt_fields.local_whisper_note: No keys needed. The model downloads on first session and runs entirely on this machine.

audio.title: Check your audio
audio.body: Bad audio is the most common reason a first call goes wrong. Half a minute here saves that.
audio.session_running: A session is recording right now. Stop it to run the audio check, or skip this step.
audio.mic_listening: Say a few words — the bar should cross the line.
audio.mic_quiet: Very quiet. Move closer, or raise the input level in your system sound settings.
audio.mic_silent: No signal from this microphone. Check that it isn't muted, or pick another one.
audio.mic_failed: Can't open the microphone ({{error}}). Allow microphone access in your system privacy settings, then come back.
audio.system_title: the other side of the call
audio.system_hint: Records what you hear, so the other people on the call make it into the transcript.
audio.system_off: Off — only your own voice will be transcribed.
audio.system_listening: Playing three beeps — the bar should jump.
audio.system_silent: Didn't catch any sound. Check your output volume, or play something in another app (a video works) and test again.
audio.system_failed: System audio capture isn't available on this computer. Zanban will still transcribe your microphone.

done.title: You're set
done.missing_body: These providers still have no credentials, so sessions and answers won't work yet. Go back to the Keys step or add them later in Settings:
done.body: Hit <0>Start session</0> in the dashboard header to begin recording. The overlay floats over your call and, in stealth, stays invisible to screen-share.
done.hotkeys_more: They work from any app. See and change every hotkey in Settings → Hotkeys.

persona.title: What do you do?
persona.body: Pick a role so answers fit your calls — or skip. You can choose one later in Settings → Context.
